# dokku_service_expose (Data Source)

Exposes or unexposes a dokku service on host ports

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dokku_service_expose" "example" {
  service = "postgres"
  name    = "my-db"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the service instance
- `service` (String) Type of service to expose (e.g. redis, postgres, mysql)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource's identity address.
- `ports` (List of String) Host ports to expose the service on (order is significant)
